limit_behavior: non-STABLE run publishes no provisional observations; query refusal alone does not make a stable run non-STABLE
query_behavior: VALUE: supported query, queryReason=null; UNSUPPORTED_POINT: nonempty queryReason, null semantic fields, preserves requested point/subject; does not change run status
batch_behavior: STABLE with observation COMPLETE returns exactly one observation per unique requested (point, subject), including unsupported queries; incomplete observation phase returns an empty atomic batch with explicit INCOMPLETE pipeline

completion.consumer_identity: one status per requested consumer; completed consumers retained independently
completion.pipeline_success: all requested phases complete, analysis STABLE, publication acknowledged
completion.phase_limit: observation/consumer/output LIMIT never rewrites stable analysis to ANALYSIS_LIMIT
